name: How much does a tiny home project typically cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does a tiny home project typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a tiny home project varies widely depending on size, materials, customization, and whether it's on a foundation or wheels. A basic shell might start from around $30,000, while a fully custom, turn-key tiny home can range from $80,000 to over $150,000. Factors like appliances, off-grid systems, specialized finishes, and site preparation costs will influence the final price. We provide detailed estimates tailored to your specific project needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tiny home project costs typically range from $30,000 for a basic shell to over $150,000 for a custom, turn-key build, varying with size, materials, and features.
